jobs.title: FPGA Engineer - Trading Systems
jobs.content: <p>Hudson River Trading is hiring an FPGA Engineer to design and verify low-latency trading logic in Verilog and SystemVerilog. You will work on hardware acceleration of our order entry path and market data feed handlers.</p>

jobs.title: Low Latency C++ Software Engineer
jobs.content: <p>HRT seeks a low-latency C++ engineer to optimize our trading systems down to the nanosecond. Experience with kernel bypass, lock-free data structures and cache-aware programming is a plus.</p>
